title: Slow Kyoto, side streets and quiet teahouses
summary: A relaxed five-day loop through Kyoto built around early mornings, small neighborhood walks, and one unhurried tea ceremony. Skips the biggest tourist bottlenecks in favor of side-street cafés, local bathhouses, and a couple of half-day train escapes.
pace: One anchor activity per day, lots of unstructured wandering.

logistics.transit: Two legs by local train, otherwise on foot
logistics.bestTime: Early mornings and just after sunset for popular sites

highlights: A 7am walk through a near-empty Philosopher's Path
An afternoon at a family-run tofu kappo the model picked from a side street
A half-day in Arashiyama before the tour buses arrive
